cards.ex: We're all inherently flawed, so it's important to be forgiving of each other.
cards.exUz: Hammayam tug'ma nuqsonli, shuning uchun bir-birimizni kechirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Aslidan kamchiligi bor, tabiatan xato qilishga moyil.

cards.ex: His deep-seated resentment towards his father stemmed from childhood neglect.
cards.exUz: Uning otasiga nisbatan chuqur xafagarchiligi bolaligidagi e'tiborsizlikdan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri saqlanib qolgan, kuchli norozilik hissi.

cards.ex: The dog's unwavering loyalty to its owner was truly touching.
cards.exUz: Itning o'z egasiga bo'lgan sadoqati juda ta'sirli edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday sharoitda o'zgarmaydigan, qat'iy sodiqlik.

cards.ex: She's such a control freak; she has to micromanage everything.
cards.exUz: U shunaqangi nazoratparastki, hamma narsani o'zi boshqarishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani nazorat qilishni xohlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: The dictator was utterly ruthless in suppressing any dissent.
cards.exUz: Diktator har qanday norozilikni bostirishda butunlay shafqatsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday rahm-shafqat qilmaydigan, juda shafqatsiz.

cards.ex: He's a shrewd negotiator; he always gets the best deal.
cards.exUz: U ayyor muzokarach; u har doim eng yaxshi kelishuvga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda o'z maqsadiga erishish uchun aql ishlatadigan odam.

cards.ex: He flew off the handle when he found out about the damage to his car.
cards.exUz: U mashinasiga yetkazilgan zararni bilib, jahli chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda g'azablanish, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: Her nurturing nature made her a natural caregiver.
cards.exUz: Uning mehribon tabiatiga ko'ra, u tabiiy g'amxo'r edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga g'amxo'rlik qilish va yordam berishga moyillik.

cards.ex: The politician demonstrated his moral fiber by refusing the bribe.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi porani rad etish orqali o'zining axloqiy tamoyillarini namoyish etdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining axloqiy tamoyillariga sodiq qolish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He's chronically indecisive; it takes him ages to choose what to eat.
cards.exUz: U surunkali qarorsiz; nima yeyishni tanlash uchun ko'p vaqt ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda qaror qabul qilishda qiynaladigan odam.

cards.ex: His blind ambition led him to betray his friends.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'r maqsadparastligi uni do'stlariga xiyonat qilishga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsaga qaramay maqsadga erishishga intilish.

cards.ex: He's a glutton for punishment; he keeps signing up for marathons.
cards.exUz: U azobga o'ch; u doimo marafonlarga yoziladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklardan zavq oladigan, o'zini qiynashni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: We all have inherent biases, whether we realize it or not.
cards.exUz: Barchamizda tug'ma xolislik bor, buni anglasak ham, anglamasak ham.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatan mavjud bo'lgan, o'z-o'zidan paydo bo'lgan xolislik.

cards.ex: Her genuine humility was refreshing in such a competitive environment.
cards.exUz: Uning chinakam kamtarligi shunday raqobatbardosh muhitda tetiklantirardi.
cards.uzDef: Samimiy va soxta bo'lmagan kamtarlik.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; let's hear what she has to say first.
cards.exUz: Xulosa chiqarishga shoshilmang; avval uning nima deyishini eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni to'liq bilmasdan oldin xulosaga kelish.

cards.ex: She was a pillar of strength for her family after her husband's death.
cards.exUz: Eri vafotidan keyin u oilasi uchun kuch ustuni bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda boshqalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's fiercely independent and prefers to do things her own way.
cards.exUz: U qattiq mustaqil va ishlarni o'zicha qilishni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga ishonadigan va boshqalarga tayanishni istamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He has a silver tongue and can convince anyone of anything.
cards.exUz: Uning chuchuk zaboni bor va u har kimni har narsaga ishontira oladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni ishontirish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She was deeply compassionate and always willing to help those in need.
cards.exUz: U juda rahmdil edi va har doim yordamga muhtojlarga yordam berishga tayyor edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga chuqur achinish va rahm qilish hissi.

cards.ex: I think we got our wires crossed; I thought you were bringing the drinks.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz chalkashib ketdik; men siz ichimliklarni olib keladi deb o'ylagandim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunish, adashib ketish.

cards.ex: The company found itself in a moral quagmire after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Shu bahs-munozaradan keyin kompaniya axloqiy botqoqlikda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab va noaniq axloqiy vaziyat.

cards.ex: His unflappable demeanor helped him to stay calm under pressure.
cards.exUz: Uning xotirjam xulq-atvori bosim ostida xotirjam qolishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday vaziyatda hayajonlanmaydigan yoki tashvishlanmaydigan xulq-atvor.

cards.ex: Well, that was a mistake, but live and learn, I guess.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, bu xato edi, lekin yashaymiz va o'rganamiz, shekilli.
cards.uzDef: Tajribadan saboq olish, xatolardan o'rganish.

cards.ex: Despite facing many obstacles, she pursued her dream with quiet determination.
cards.exUz: Ko'p to'siqlarga duch kelishiga qaramay, u orzusini jimjit qat'iyat bilan amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadiga erishish uchun sabr bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's such a social butterfly; she knows everyone at the party.
cards.exUz: U shunaqangi ijtimoiy kapalak; u ziyofatdagi hamma odamni taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma bilan oson muloqot qiladigan, ijtimoiy odam.

cards.ex: She's remarkably resilient; she always bounces back from adversity.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib bardoshli; u doimo qiyinchiliklardan keyin o'ziga keladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni osonlikcha yengib o'tadigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a creature of habit and always eats the same breakfast.
cards.exUz: U odat mahsuli va doimo bir xil nonushta qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlariga qattiq rioya qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Her infectious enthusiasm made the project fun for everyone.
cards.exUz: Uning yuqumli ishtiyoqi loyihani hamma uchun qiziqarli qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga ham o'tadigan ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: Trying to convince him to change his mind is a lost cause.
cards.exUz: Uni fikrini o'zgartirishga ko'ndirish - umidsiz ish.
cards.uzDef: Muammo hal qilib bo'lmaydigan darajada yomon.

cards.ex: Despite everything, I believe in the inherent goodness of people.
cards.exUz: Hamma narsaga qaramay, men odamlarning tug'ma yaxshiligiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Inson tabiatida bo'lgan yaxshilik xislati.
